decision_authority: D038 Prediction Leaderboard (LEADERBOARD_SPEC.md, frozen 2026-08-06); D036 measurement semantics retained in full
freeze_note: Frozen BEFORE any our-model evaluation result was visible. Per the spec, the scoring transformation, interpretation bands and tolerance bands may never be changed to improve presentation. Changing any value in this file requires a new version string and a decision record.

prediction_score.formula: score = clamp(50 + 100 * skill, 0, 100); skill = (baseline_error - model_error) / baseline_error
prediction_score.rounding: round half to even to nearest integer (Python 3 round)
prediction_score.interpretation: One score point = one percentage point of error reduced relative to the declared baseline on the identical evaluation universe. 50 = exactly baseline quality. 100 = error halved (or better). 0 = error at least 50% worse than baseline.
never_rules: The score is NEVER a normalization of raw MAE across unrelated units.
The score NEVER mixes evidence strength or market edge; those are separate axes (accuracy / beats-market / certainty).
No attractive placeholder scores: an unevaluated target is TBD, never a number.

eligibility.universe_match_rule: exact string equality of the declared universe AND identical N between the model row and the baseline row; unmatched universes are never compared and never normalized

bands.label: Exceptional
bands.plain: at least 40% lower error than the basic model

bands.label: Strong
bands.plain: 30-39% lower error than the basic model

bands.label: Useful
bands.plain: 20-29% lower error than the basic model

bands.label: Modest skill
bands.plain: 10-19% lower error than the basic model

bands.label: About basic-baseline quality
bands.plain: 0-9% lower error than the basic model

bands.label: No demonstrated improvement
bands.plain: not better than the basic model on this evidence

tolerance_bands.note: Declared target ranges for the 'Within Target Range' column, frozen before viewing any model results; never changed to improve presentation. Targets without a declared band show 'no target range declared' and never inherit another target's band.

labels.pending_model: Pending — our model has not completed an evaluated run for this target
labels.pending_baseline: Pending — matched baseline not yet computed on this universe
labels.pending_universe_mismatch: Pending — matched universe — the model is evaluated and the baseline is evaluated, but not on the identical universe (exact universe-string + identical N required); the paired legacy-vs-baseline run on the SAME universe has not been done, and this is never derived from the unmatched universes on file

market_advantage.direction: positive = our model beats market consensus on the target-appropriate metric
market_advantage.formula: advantage = (market_error - model_error) / market_error, computed only on timestamp-matched, identical universes with the documented consensus method
market_advantage.never_collapse_rule: MAE, Brier, log-loss and ROI are never collapsed into one number; each target uses its declared metric, translated to a common direction (positive = we did better); the methodology layer shows the raw comparison.
eligibility: same games / player-games (identical matched universe: exact universe-string equality and identical N)
documented consensus method (de-vig method preregistered by hash)
no hindsight best-book-per-outcome selection, ever (fixed pre-declared book identities only)

best_of_three_naive_pooled.selection_rule: the variant with the lowest pooled MAE in granular/player_granular_metrics.json; deterministic, values read verbatim, never recomputed

naive_trio_declared_pending.note: required by D036 point 6 on every target; until computed with walk-forward leakage discipline on the identical universe, every dependent Prediction Score stays TBD

win_probability_baseline_declared_pendin.candidate: home-court constant-probability baseline, to be preregistered before first scored evaluation
win_probability_baseline_declared_pendin.note: no baseline artifact exists; score stays TBD

team_possessions_baseline_declared_pendi.candidate: naive team-possessions baseline (league mean / rolling team average / last-five-games), to be preregistered before first scored evaluation
team_possessions_baseline_declared_pendi.note: D042: the model number (team_possessions_champion) is now VERIFIED, but no matched-universe naive baseline has been computed for this target; per D036 point 6 the Prediction Score stays TBD until one is computed with walk-forward leakage discipline on the identical universe -- never invented, never inherited from the turnovers baseline

definitions.VERIFIED: audited blind walk-forward or adequate prospective evaluation
definitions.PROMISING: positive retrospective result, not yet confirmed by audit
definitions.PRELIMINARY: small sample, exploratory, or legacy-receiptable evidence

evidence_badges.never_sealed_rule: never SEALED before an evaluation ran; lifecycle BUILT → AUDITED → FITTING → EVALUATED/SEALED → ADJUDICATED; implementation test counts live in operational progress only

display.subtext_template: Usually within {miss} {unit} of the actual result
display.benchmark_subtext_template: No model prediction evaluated yet — the basic benchmark ({baseline}) is usually within {miss} {unit} of the actual result
display.note: readable 1-decimal rounding in the leaderboard; raw 4-decimal values remain in the evidence layer and in every hover popover

rules: 1. rows with a numeric Prediction Score first, ordered by evidence badge (VERIFIED before PROMISING before PRELIMINARY), then score descending
2. evaluated rows without a score (measured model, matched baseline pending) next, by evidence badge
3. unevaluated targets last, in registry order

defaults.filter_note: the archive currently supports pooled regular-season evaluation only; season and cutoff filters expose the single pooled option until per-season leaderboard splits are published. Filters only hide rows; they never alter a metric value.

player_leaderboard.locked_text: Player-level leaderboards are collecting sufficient verified samples.
unlock_requirements: minimum verified sample per player per stat family (min_n_player_stat = 40 evaluated player-games)
player-specific baseline difficulty (score vs that player's own best naive baseline, never raw MAE)
market-matched universe for any market-advantage ranking
uncertainty shrinkage toward the population mean before ranking
team-change handling (no cross-team pooling without adjustment)
player_leaderboard.never_rule: never rank players by raw MAE alone
